title: finding(components): `element:record_picker`'s published `limit` input description states `PRECEDENCE: dataSource.limit ?? limit ?? 50`, which objectui#10016 (a refused binding cap is not authored) makes false
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the contract review of PR objectui#10389 (objectui#10016), boundary flag ③, marked "should be filed". ⛔ Not graded and not routed: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are the triage seat's.

## Fact

`packages/components/src/renderers/basic/record-picker.tsx:439` (at `origin/main`) is the authoring-facing description of `element:record_picker`'s `limit` input. It ends:

> PRECEDENCE: `dataSource.limit ?? limit ?? 50` — a node-level binding wins outright.

Under ruling A on objectui#10016 (`5749674763`), landing in PR objectui#10389, a binding `limit` the contract refuses (`0`, negative, non-integer) is **not authored**: the resolver falls through to the saved view's usable cap, then to the consumer default. A refused `dataSource.limit` therefore does not 「win outright」. The contract reviewer also reads the sentence as already wrong twice before this change: the picker's old `if (limit)` guard sent no `$top` at all for a binding `0`, so a refused binding never won outright even then.

The reviewer also flags, as non-blocking, that `content/docs/guide/data-source.md` describes the binding's `sort` / `limit` overriding the view without mentioning a refused binding cap. It is incomplete rather than wrong; the taker should reconcile both texts in one stroke.

## Seam

`core:composeElementDataSource` precedence (objectui#10016) → authoring description of `components:element:record_picker.limit` + `content/docs/guide/data-source.md`.

## ⛔ Not claimed

- ⛔ No wording chosen. The description should state the precedence the resolver implements: a usable binding cap, then the view's usable cap, then the picker's `limit`, then 50. The taker re-derives it from the merged code.
- This is text only; the picker's behaviour already follows the ruling through the shared composer.

## Dedupe words

`record_picker limit precedence description` · `dataSource.limit ?? limit ?? 50` · `refused binding cap record picker` · `data-source guide limit override view`
